name: Traditional Holiday Southern Pecan Pie (Whole Nut Stricture Warning)
whyItWorks: Layered with dozens of crunchy, whole toasted pecan halves bound in concentrated corn syrup and brown sugar. Pecan halves do not break down smoothly and present a dangerous stricture blockage risk.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Trigger warning item: avoid during active flares or stricturing Crohn's. Choose smooth pumpkin pie instead.
watchOuts: Dense whole pecan nuts pose serious mechanical obstruction risks
